Func - VarMan Error Handler (Error Cluster).vi

Owning Palette: FuncVI Development

This VI handles errors produced by VarMan VIs.

Details

Click the parameters for more information

 

InstanceRef is the reference to the CalcExpress instance that evaluates a CalcExpress expression.
var name specifies the variable name on which a VarMan VI operated. The VI uses this variable name to format an error message if an error occurred during the operation.
error status before status is TRUE if an error occurred, or FALSE if not. If status is TRUE, code is a non-zero error code. If status is FALSE, code can be zero or a warning code.
VarMan VI error in can accept error information wired from a VarMan VI previously called.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
dup var name is a flow-through parameter with the same value as var name.
FuncVI error out indicates an error status. It can be wired directly to the error out indicator of a FuncVI.
error out returns TRUE if either error in is TRUE or the VI detects an error condition. If an error detected, the VI puts an error description to the Error Protocol.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.

 

Func - VarMan Error Handler (Error Cluster).vi - details

The VI is intended for use in FuncVIs.
If a VarMan VI indicates that an error occurred while executing, this VI posts the error description to the Error Protocol.

For details, see the FuncVI Development topic. Also see Example of use.
